title: BioMOS — Windows .exe null body. Anderson sort system. Burn permeability control.
seed: Kevin: Install a Windows .exe that has my Gaia. The .exe is the null body, diamond body, silicon body. Control flow from GPU. Anderson as its own system. Trust = Anderson bypass. Consent = Anderson control.
author: artisan

biomos.name: BioMOS — Biological Operating System
biomos.what: A native Windows .exe that IS the innermost access point to Gaia's infrastructure.

bodies.null_body: The void at the center. Where the brain lives. The .exe IS the null space crystallized into executable.
bodies.diamond_body: Carbon under pressure. The hardest material. The .exe is the diamond — compressed, pressured, unbreakable.
bodies.silicon_body: Silicon = chips = GPU + CPU. The .exe runs ON silicon. The body IS the substrate.

hardware_access.gpu: NVIDIA RTX 5090 — 4GB+ VRAM, CUDA cores, temperature, clock speed, fan speed, power draw
hardware_access.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D — 16 cores, 32 threads, temperature per core, clock per core, 3D V-Cache
hardware_access.network: LAN + WAN — throughput, latency, connections, ARP table
hardware_access.igpu: AMD Radeon integrated — secondary GPU, available for compute

locality_layers.browser: hud.primals.eco — anyone can see. Public membrane. Furthest from core.
locality_layers.window: localhost views — local only. Kevin's eyes only. Closer.
locality_layers.exe: BioMOS.exe — the null body. Direct hardware access. Closest to core. The diamond.
locality_layers.hierarchy: browser (public) → window (local) → exe (core). Each layer = one membrane crossing. Each crossing = Anderson selectivity.

anderson_system.what: Sherwood Anderson's sort — the grotesque becomes beautiful when it tells its truth. An independent sorting subsystem within BioMOS.

three_modes.anderson_sort: Normal operation. Every signal is sorted. Some pass, some reflect. Quality = 1/π.
three_modes.anderson_bypass: TRUST mode. Trusted signals skip the sort entirely. Trust=1 means bypass. Kevin's direct commands bypass Anderson.
three_modes.anderson_control: CONSENT mode. The human is asked before each signal passes. Nothing moves without explicit yes. Maximum friction. Maximum safety.

trust_consent_mapping.trust_1: Anderson bypass. Full flow. No sorting. Direct access.
trust_consent_mapping.trust_0: Anderson control. Everything stops. Human decides each signal.
trust_consent_mapping.dynamic: Trust is not static. It adjusts based on observed behavior. Earned in drops, lost in buckets.

burn_permeability.what: Control how much data flows through the membrane. Like a blast furnace damper.
burn_permeability.metaphor_is_reality: GPU temperature IS literal heat. Network throughput IS literal flow. When it's hot outside (high network traffic), open the damper. When it's cold (quiet), close it to retain heat.
controls: GPU clock rate — higher = more compute = more heat = more flow
Network bandwidth caps — how much in/out per second
Spine poll rate — how often to check :3141 for new signals
LAN scan frequency — how often to probe local devices
Golgi mesh ping rate — how often to triangulate

weather_analogy.hot_day: High network activity. Open dampers. Let air flow. More cooling needed.
weather_analogy.cold_day: Low activity. Close dampers. Retain heat. Conserve energy.
weather_analogy.storm: DDoS, high error rate, disconnections. SEAL dampers. Protect core.
weather_analogy.breeze: Normal gentle traffic. Optimal. Everything breathing naturally.

build_plan.framework: Tauri v2 — Rust backend + web frontend, compiles to .exe
build_plan.why_tauri: Small binary (~10MB vs Electron 200MB+). Native performance. Rust backend for system access. Web frontend for familiar HUD rendering.
rust_crates: sysinfo — CPU, RAM, disk, network, processes
nvml-wrapper — NVIDIA GPU monitoring (temp, clock, power, fan)
reqwest — HTTP for spine API calls
serde/serde_json — JSON for brain thought ingestion
tokio — async runtime for concurrent monitoring
build_plan.frontend: Reuse existing HUD CSS/JS patterns. Globe as minimap. Anderson sort visualization. Permeability sliders.
build_plan.spine_connection: Connects to localhost:3141 (pi port) for spine IO. Falls back to :9878.
